title: gdpr.section.erased
description: Receipt for one erasure, echoing the correlation_id of the gdpr.erasure.requested (or deprecated user.deleted) event that asked. This module sends {owner: "billing", subject_type: "account", subject_key, correlation_id, receipt_id, counts: {wallets, subscriptions, transactions, credit_holds, webhook_events}} in the same transaction as the erasure, so a rollback takes the receipt with it. The shape below is the ACTION's contract, not this emitter's subset: comm registers one schema per action name across the whole process, so it must keep accepting the older {user_id, service} spelling other owners still send (stapel-gdpr 0.5.0 accepts both).
